command:
set -euo pipefail
expected=2f9fa1004ab140eb312302f799bf2e6165c4aff6
[[ "$(hostname)" == andreas-MACO && "$(id -un)" == andreas ]] || exit 101
[[ "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" == "$expected" ]] || { echo HEAD_MISMATCH >&2; exit 102; }
state=$(systemctl show entityos-vm.service -p ActiveState --value)
[[ "$state" == inactive || "$state" == failed ]] || { echo "VM_NOT_INACTIVE state=$state" >&2; exit 103; }
rescue=/var/lib/entityos/data/volatile-state-rescue/fred-20260913T0246p0700/MANIFEST.json
sudo -n test -f "$rescue" || { echo RESCUE_MISSING >&2; exit 104; }
tmpdrop=/etc/systemd/system/entityos-vm.service.d/99-omega-stage-holding.conf
cleanup(){ sudo -n rm -f "$tmpdrop"; sudo -n systemctl daemon-reload; }
trap cleanup EXIT
printf '[Service]\nExecCondition=\nExecCondition=/usr/local/libexec/entityos/fluechtig-vor-start-pruefen.sh\nExecStopPost=\n' | sudo -n tee "$tmpdrop" >/dev/null
sudo -n chmod 0644 "$tmpdrop"
sudo -n systemctl daemon-reload
eff=$(systemctl show entityos-vm.service -p ExecCondition -p ExecStopPost -p DropInPaths --no-pager)
printf 'STAGE_EFFECTIVE_BEGIN\n%s\nSTAGE_EFFECTIVE_END\n' "$eff"
[[ "$eff" == *'/usr/local/libexec/entityos/fluechtig-vor-start-pruefen.sh'* ]] || { echo HOLDING_NOT_EFFECTIVE >&2; exit 105; }
[[ -z "$(systemctl show entityos-vm.service -p ExecStopPost --value)" ]] || { echo EXECSTOPPOST_NOT_EMPTY >&2; exit 106; }
sudo -n /usr/local/libexec/entityos/semantic-state-cutover.py stage --execute
sudo -n /usr/local/libexec/entityos/semantic-state-cutover.py verify
manifest=/var/lib/entityos/data/semantic-state/CUTOVER.json
sudo -n test -f "$manifest" || { echo CUTOVER_MANIFEST_MISSING >&2; exit 107; }
manifest_sha=$(sudo -n sha256sum "$manifest" | awk '{print $1}')
trap - EXIT
cleanup
final_eff=$(systemctl show entityos-vm.service -p ExecCondition -p ExecStopPost -p DropInPaths --no-pager)
printf 'FINAL_EFFECTIVE_BEGIN\n%s\nFINAL_EFFECTIVE_END\n' "$final_eff"
[[ "$final_eff" == *'/usr/local/libexec/entityos/semantic-state-cutover.py condition'* ]] || { echo CUTOVER_CONDITION_NOT_EFFECTIVE >&2; exit 108; }
[[ "$final_eff" != *'99-omega-stage-holding.conf'* ]] || { echo TEMP_DROPIN_STILL_EFFECTIVE >&2; exit 109; }
[[ -z "$(systemctl show entityos-vm.service -p ExecStopPost --value)" ]] || { echo FINAL_EXECSTOPPOST_NOT_EMPTY >&2; exit 110; }
sudo -n /usr/local/libexec/entityos/semantic-state-cutover.py condition
echo "CUTOVER_MANIFEST_SHA=$manifest_sha"
echo 'DURABLE_STATE_BEGIN'
sudo -n find /var/lib/entityos/data/semantic-state -maxdepth 5 -type f -printf '%P %s bytes\n' | sort
echo 'DURABLE_STATE_END'
echo 'BINDS_BEGIN'
sudo -n grep '^ENTITYOS_IDENTITY_BINDS=' /etc/entityos/entityos.conf
echo 'BINDS_END'
echo "POST_STAGE state=$(systemctl show entityos-vm.service -p ActiveState --value) VERIFY=PASS CONDITION=PASS TEMP_HOLDING_REMOVED=1 NO_START=1"
